key_insight: Residual-informed Bayesian neural operators learn and quantify surrogate inadequacy using PDE-based error estimates, improving inference and design with fewer full-order training simulations.
engineering_relevance: More reliable PDE surrogates can accelerate digital twins, parameter estimation and risk-averse engineering design without ignoring surrogate error.
method: Estimate operator inadequacy from governing-PDE residuals using a posteriori error estimates.
Incorporate inadequacy correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction.
Establish local error bounds under stability and smoothness assumptions.
evidence_signal: Across reaction–diffusion, glioma inference and 3D thermal-break design examples, RI-BNO improved agreement with FE references using half as many full nonlinear or transient training simulations as vanilla BNO; thermal-break online optimization fell from 178 hours with FE to 18 minutes.
watch_item: Error guarantees are local and depend on stability and smoothness assumptions; reliability beyond the evaluated regimes requires validation.
paper_title: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design
